answers.Are ads paying back?: Revenue ROAS 3.78 (30d) and 2.32 (90d); non-brand has sold nothing from 18 days of clicks (£441.97). Profit UNKNOWN.
answers.What is at risk today?: Google Ads card declined; #1040 slot due this evening; #1043 assembly price; 7 customers waiting; trade ramp to 140/day on 25 Nov; #1020 £273.59 possibly owed.
answers.Can we scale?: No. Profit unverified, capacity UNKNOWN, card declined, non-brand dry. Only £0-cost work: Side Lift merchandising, organic snippets, reviews after delivery.
answers.What must I do today?: Fix the Ads card; send the #1040 slot; decide #1043; reply to E010, E011, E021, E022, E023, E002 and Ivywell; check abandoned-cart automation is Active; check PayPal #1020; say HOLD AT 80.
